address: Rua Joaquim Antunes 108, São Paulo, 05415-000, Brazil
bio: It is not always a given to find a restaurant that is fully able to express a chef’s desire and passion for food, life, art and nature, but this is definitely the case at Evvai, where chef Luiz Filipe Souza’s cooking is a successful fusion of Brazilian and Italian influences which result in dishes that are not only visually attractive but also teeming with skill, knowledge and balance. This is showcased on a single tasting menu, Oriundi (symbolising the interchange between cultures), featuring delicate appetisers that fly the flag for both Brazil and Italy. An impressive dish that has been a constant on the menu here in one form or another is “bomba al nero / lardo from the Serra da Bocaina”.
